args.summary: checkout-api deployed v2.3.1 to production failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. In response, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all three regions. Post-rollback verification: service healthy on v2.3.0, error rate reduced to 0.2%. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy per deployment history and should not be re-deployed without remediation.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Problem:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions, with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. Verified recovery — the service is now healthy on v2.3.0, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the rollback and post-rollback status.
